```{r}
# Load additional colour palette packages
library(unikn, quietly = TRUE)
library(RColorBrewer, quietly = TRUE)

library(scales, quietly = TRUE)

# Define a set of custom color palettes from the unikn package

# Display the custom palettes

# Define a second set of custom palettes from the RColorBrewer and yarrr packages

brew_ext <- usecol(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "Spectral"), n = 12)

yarrr_mod <- usecol(c(piratepal("ipod")), n = 9)
```

```{r}
# ---- Path helpers -----------------------------------------------------------------
variant_dir <- function(experiment, donor) {
    file.path(
        local_wd_folder, "results", "per_sample", experiment, donor,
        "dna_cnv", "variants", "all_variants"
    )
}
variant_matrix_path <- function(experiment, donor) {
    file.path(variant_dir(experiment, donor), "NGT_all_variants.csv")
}
variant_metadata_path <- function(experiment, donor) {
    file.path(variant_dir(experiment, donor), "variant_metadata_all_variants.csv")
}

# ---- Matching helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
norm_key <- function(x) gsub("[[:space:]]+", "", toupper(trimws(as.character(x))))

norm_protein <- function(x) {
    x   <- trimws(as.character(x))
    out <- sub("^.*?p\\.", "", x, perl = TRUE)
    out <- sub("^p\\.", "", out, perl = TRUE)
    out[!grepl("p\\.", x, perl = TRUE)] <- NA_character_
    out[is.na(x) | !nzchar(x) | out %in% c("?", "", "NA")] <- NA_character_
    norm_key(out)
}

resolve_curated_ids <- function(meta, curated_sub, sample_id) {
    gene_col <- grep("^gene$",    colnames(meta), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
    cdna_col <- grep("^cdna$",    colnames(meta), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
    prot_col <- grep("^protein$", colnames(meta), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]

    if (is.na(gene_col) || is.na(cdna_col)) {
        stop("Metadata for ", sample_id, " lacks Gene/cDNA columns. Have: ",
             paste(head(colnames(meta), 40), collapse = ", "))
    }

    meta_key  <- paste(norm_key(meta[[gene_col]]), norm_key(meta[[cdna_col]]))
    meta_prot <- if (is.na(prot_col)) rep(NA_character_, nrow(meta))
                 else norm_protein(meta[[prot_col]])

    do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(curated_sub)), function(i) {
        key  <- paste(norm_key(curated_sub$gene[i]), norm_key(curated_sub$cdna[i]))
        hits <- which(meta_key == key)

        if (length(hits) > 1 && !is.na(curated_sub$aa_change[i])) {
            want    <- norm_key(sub("^p\\.", "", curated_sub$aa_change[i]))
            refined <- hits[which(meta_prot[hits] == want)]
            if (length(refined) >= 1) hits <- refined
        }

        data.frame(
            sample_id  = sample_id,
            gene       = curated_sub$gene[i],
            cdna       = curated_sub$cdna[i],
            aa_change  = curated_sub$aa_change[i],
            variant_id = if (length(hits) == 0) NA_character_
                        else meta[[".variant_id"]][hits[1]],
            n_hits     = length(hits),
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
    }))
}

build_label <- function(gene, cdna, aa_change, variant_id) {
    parts <- strsplit(variant_id, ":", fixed = TRUE)
    pos   <- vapply(parts, `[`, character(1), 2)
    refalt <- strsplit(vapply(parts, `[`, character(1), 3), "/", fixed = TRUE)
    ref <- vapply(refalt, function(x) if (length(x) >= 1) x[1] else "", character(1))
    alt <- vapply(refalt, function(x) if (length(x) >= 2) x[2] else "", character(1))
    aa <- ifelse(is.na(aa_change), "NA", aa_change)
    paste(gene, cdna, aa, pos, ref, alt, sep = "_")
}

# Same key format used for aligning DNA to combined:
# <single-cell barcode> + '__' + <terminal sample tag>
make_cell_key <- function(cell_names) {
    key <- sub(
        "^.*(?:\\.|_)([^._]+)_(PT[0-9]+(?:FU)?)$",
        "\\1__\\2",
        cell_names,
        perl = TRUE
    )
    valid <- grepl(
        "^.*(?:\\.|_)[^._]+_(PT[0-9]+(?:FU)?)$",
        cell_names,
        perl = TRUE
    )
    key[!valid] <- NA_character_
    key
}

align_curated_dna_to_seurat <- function(df, sample_id, sample_id_to_suffix,
                                        seurat_name_lookup) {
    suffix   <- sample_id_to_suffix[[sample_id]]
    dna_keys <- paste0(rownames(df), "__", suffix)

    matched_seurat_names <- unname(seurat_name_lookup[dna_keys])
    matched_idx <- !is.na(matched_seurat_names)

    new_rownames <- rownames(df)
    new_rownames[matched_idx] <- matched_seurat_names[matched_idx]

    if (anyDuplicated(new_rownames)) {
        stop("Duplicate row names created while aligning ", sample_id, " to combined.")
    }

    rownames(df) <- new_rownames
    attr(df, "n_matched_to_seurat")   <- sum(matched_idx)
    attr(df, "n_unmatched_to_seurat") <- sum(!matched_idx)
    df
}

# ---- Per-sample load + resolve + targeted read -------------------------------------
DNA_data_list   <- setNames(vector("list", nrow(variant_manifest)),
                            variant_manifest$sample_id)
resolution_list <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(variant_manifest))) {
    sample_id  <- variant_manifest$sample_id[i]
    experiment <- variant_manifest$experiment[i]
    donor      <- variant_manifest$donor[i]

    curated_sub <- curated_variants[curated_variants$sample_id == sample_id, ,
                                    drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(curated_sub) == 0) {
        message("Skipping ", sample_id, " — no curated variants")
        next
    }

    message("Loading ", sample_id, " (", experiment, "/", donor, "), ",
            nrow(curated_sub), " curated variant(s) ...")

    meta_path <- variant_metadata_path(experiment, donor)
    if (!file.exists(meta_path)) stop("Metadata not found: ", meta_path)

    meta <- as.data.frame(
        fread(meta_path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, showProgress = FALSE)
    )
    meta[[".variant_id"]] <- as.character(meta[[1]])

    resolved <- resolve_curated_ids(meta, curated_sub, sample_id)
    resolution_list[[sample_id]] <- resolved

    found_ids <- unique(na.omit(resolved$variant_id))
    if (length(found_ids) == 0) {
        warning("No curated variant resolved for ", sample_id)
        rm(meta); gc(verbose = FALSE)
        next
    }
    rm(meta); gc(verbose = FALSE)

    ngt_path <- variant_matrix_path(experiment, donor)
    if (!file.exists(ngt_path)) stop("NGT matrix not found: ", ngt_path)

    header <- names(fread(ngt_path, nrows = 0, check.names = FALSE))
    bc_col <- header[1]

    missing_cols <- setdiff(found_ids, header)
    if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
        stop("Resolved variant ID(s) absent from the NGT header for ",
             sample_id, ": ", paste(head(missing_cols, 3), collapse = ", "))
    }

    ngt_dt <- fread(
        ngt_path, select = c(bc_col, found_ids),
        header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, showProgress = FALSE
    )

    barcodes <- as.character(ngt_dt[[bc_col]])
    ngt_dt[, (bc_col) := NULL]

    ngt <- as.matrix(ngt_dt)
    storage.mode(ngt) <- "integer"
    rownames(ngt) <- barcodes

    lab <- resolved[!is.na(resolved$variant_id), , drop = FALSE]
    lab$label <- build_label(lab$gene, lab$cdna, lab$aa_change, lab$variant_id)

    colnames(ngt) <- make.unique(
        lab$label[match(colnames(ngt), lab$variant_id)], sep = "."
    )

    DNA_data_list[[sample_id]] <- as.data.frame(ngt, check.names = FALSE)

    rm(ngt_dt, ngt)
    gc(verbose = FALSE)
}

DNA_data_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), DNA_data_list)

# ---- Resolution report --------------------------------------------------------------
resolution_summary <- do.call(rbind, unname(resolution_list))
rownames(resolution_summary) <- NULL

unresolved <- resolution_summary[is.na(resolution_summary$variant_id), , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(unresolved) > 0) {
    cat("Unresolved (", nrow(unresolved), ") — likely non-standard HGVS or ",
        "homopolymer left-alignment mismatch:\n", sep = "")
    print(unresolved[, c("sample_id", "gene", "cdna", "aa_change")], row.names = FALSE)
}

ambiguous <- resolution_summary[resolution_summary$n_hits > 1, , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(ambiguous) > 0) {
    cat("\nAmbiguous — several coordinate IDs shared one gene+cDNA:\n")
    print(ambiguous[, c("sample_id", "gene", "cdna", "aa_change", "n_hits")],
          row.names = FALSE)
}

cat("\nLoaded matrices (pre-alignment):\n")
print(data.frame(
    Sample     = names(DNA_data_list),
    n_cells    = vapply(DNA_data_list, nrow, integer(1)),
    n_variants = vapply(DNA_data_list, ncol, integer(1)),
    row.names  = NULL
), row.names = FALSE)

# ---- Align every matrix's barcodes to combined ---------------------------------------
sample_id_to_suffix <- setNames(
    gsub("_FU$", "FU", names(DNA_data_list)),
    names(DNA_data_list)
)

seurat_cells <- colnames(combined)
seurat_keys  <- make_cell_key(seurat_cells)

if (anyNA(seurat_keys)) {
    stop("Could not parse ", sum(is.na(seurat_keys)), " Seurat cell names.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(seurat_keys)) {
    stop("Duplicated Seurat barcode/sample keys detected.")
}

seurat_name_lookup <- setNames(seurat_cells, seurat_keys)

DNA_data_list <- setNames(
    lapply(names(DNA_data_list), function(sample_id) {
        align_curated_dna_to_seurat(
            DNA_data_list[[sample_id]], sample_id,
            sample_id_to_suffix, seurat_name_lookup
        )
    }),
    names(DNA_data_list)
)

for (sample_id in names(DNA_data_list)) {
    assign(paste0("DNA_", sample_id), DNA_data_list[[sample_id]], envir = .GlobalEnv)
}

# ---- Alignment report -----------------------------------------------------------------
alignment_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(DNA_data_list), function(sample_id) {
    df <- DNA_data_list[[sample_id]]
    data.frame(
        sample_id   = sample_id,
        n_cells     = nrow(df),
        n_matched   = attr(df, "n_matched_to_seurat"),
        n_unmatched = attr(df, "n_unmatched_to_seurat"),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
}))

print(alignment_summary, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nTotal matched across all samples:", sum(alignment_summary$n_matched),
    "/", sum(alignment_summary$n_cells), "\n")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Drop unmatched cells from each curated DNA matrix, then add
# the variant genotype columns as metadata on `combined`.
# ============================================================
# Only cells present in `combined` can be attached as metadata, so unmatched
# rows (attr n_unmatched_to_seurat) are dropped per sample first. Columns are
# added by cell name via combined@meta.data[rownames(df), col] <- df[[col]],
# so cells absent from a given sample's matrix keep NA rather than getting
# overwritten with something spurious.

stopifnot(exists("DNA_data_list"), exists("combined"))

# ---- 1. Drop unmatched rows from every sample's matrix -----------------------
DNA_data_list_matched <- lapply(names(DNA_data_list), function(sample_id) {
    df <- DNA_data_list[[sample_id]]
    matched <- rownames(df) %in% colnames(combined)

    n_before <- nrow(df)
    df <- df[matched, , drop = FALSE]

    message(sample_id, ": kept ", nrow(df), " / ", n_before,
            " cells (dropped ", n_before - nrow(df), " unmatched)")

    df
})
names(DNA_data_list_matched) <- names(DNA_data_list)

DNA_data_list <- DNA_data_list_matched
rm(DNA_data_list_matched)

for (sample_id in names(DNA_data_list)) {
    assign(paste0("DNA_", sample_id), DNA_data_list[[sample_id]], envir = .GlobalEnv)
}

# ---- 2. Combine matched cells across samples into one variant matrix --------
# Column union across samples, since not every patient carries every curated
# variant; missing genotypes default to 0 (WT/no-call), matching the earlier
# SNV-matrix convention (`x[is.na(x)] <- 0`).
all_variant_cols <- unique(unlist(lapply(DNA_data_list, colnames), use.names = FALSE))

DNA_variants_aligned <- lapply(DNA_data_list, function(df) {
    missing_cols <- setdiff(all_variant_cols, colnames(df))
    for (col_name in missing_cols) df[[col_name]] <- 0L
    df[, all_variant_cols, drop = FALSE]
})

DNA_variants_combined <- do.call(rbind, unname(DNA_variants_aligned))

if (anyDuplicated(rownames(DNA_variants_combined))) {
    stop("Duplicate cell names across samples after alignment — check for ",
         "cells matched in more than one sample's matrix.")
}

cat("\nCombined variant matrix:", nrow(DNA_variants_combined), "cells x",
    ncol(DNA_variants_combined), "variants\n")

# ---- 3. Attach as metadata on combined ---------------------------------------
# Cells not present in DNA_variants_combined (no curated variant data, or
# excluded earlier) are left as NA in combined@meta.data for these columns.
for (col_name in all_variant_cols) {
    combined@meta.data[[col_name]] <- NA_integer_
    combined@meta.data[rownames(DNA_variants_combined), col_name] <-
        DNA_variants_combined[[col_name]]
}

cat("\nAdded", length(all_variant_cols), "variant column(s) to combined metadata:\n")
print(all_variant_cols)

cat("\nCells with at least one curated variant genotype available:",
    sum(colnames(combined) %in% rownames(DNA_variants_combined)),
    "/", ncol(combined), "\n")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# TP53 status per cell, derived from curated TP53 variant genotypes
# ============================================================
# TP53_ columns are the curated TP53 variant genotypes just attached to
# combined@meta.data (build_label() prefixes every TP53 variant with
# "TP53_"). Only the columns belonging to a cell's own sample are non-NA
# for that cell — every other sample's TP53 columns stay NA, since that
# sample's matrix never had a row for this cell — so classification is done
# per cell over whichever TP53_ columns are actually populated for it.
#
# Priority when a cell has more than one TP53 variant: MUT > nGT > WT.
# A single called mutant genotype (1/2) makes the cell MUT even if another
# curated TP53 site is a no-call (3); nGT is reserved for cells where every
# curated TP53 site failed to genotype.

tp53_cols <- grep("^TP53_", colnames(combined@meta.data), value = TRUE)

if (length(tp53_cols) == 0) {
    stop("No TP53_ variant columns found in combined@meta.data. ",
         "Run the variant-metadata-attachment step first.")
}

cat("TP53 variant columns used:\n")
print(tp53_cols)

tp53_mat <- as.matrix(combined@meta.data[, tp53_cols, drop = FALSE])

has_data <- rowSums(!is.na(tp53_mat)) > 0
has_mut  <- rowSums(!is.na(tp53_mat) & tp53_mat %in% c(1, 2), na.rm = TRUE) > 0
# Recompute has_mut correctly per-row (the line above misuses %in% on a matrix;
# do it row-wise instead).
has_mut  <- apply(tp53_mat, 1, function(x) any(x %in% c(1, 2), na.rm = TRUE))
has_ngt  <- apply(tp53_mat, 1, function(x) any(x == 3, na.rm = TRUE))
all_wt   <- apply(tp53_mat, 1, function(x) {
    nx <- x[!is.na(x)]
    length(nx) > 0 && all(nx == 0)
})

combined$TP53 <- NA_character_
combined$TP53[has_data & has_mut]                 <- "MUT"
combined$TP53[has_data & !has_mut & has_ngt]       <- "nGT"
combined$TP53[has_data & !has_mut & !has_ngt & all_wt] <- "WT"

cat("\nTP53 status:\n")
print(table(combined$TP53, useNA = "ifany"))
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Load per-sample CNA/structural-variant data and attach to combined
# — combined is never subset; unmatched cells simply get NA
# ============================================================

# ---- Manifest -----------------------------------------------------------------
dna_manifest <- data.frame(
    sample_id  = c(
        "PT01", "PT02", "PT03", "PT04", "PT05", "PT06",
        "PT07", "PT08", "PT09", "PT10", "PT11", "PT12",

        "Donor_C", "Donor_B", "Donor_B", "Donor_A", "Donor_A", "Donor_B",
        "Donor_A", "Donor_A", "Donor_B", "Donor_A", "Donor_A", "Donor_B",
        "Donor_A", "Donor_B", "Donor_A", "Donor_A"
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Barcode suffix has no underscore for the two follow-up samples
# (PT15_FU -> PT15FU, PT20_FU -> PT20FU); every other sample's suffix
# equals its sample_id.
dna_manifest$suffix <- gsub("_FU$", "FU", dna_manifest$sample_id)

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(dna_manifest$sample_id))
stopifnot(exists("combined"))

# ---- 1. Load per-sample aberrancy tables, rename barcodes, merge --------------
read_dna_data <- function(experiment, donor) {
    read.csv(
        file.path(
            local_wd_folder, "results", "per_sample", experiment, donor,
            "dna_cnv", "matrices", "All_aberrancies.csv"
        ),
        header    = TRUE,
        row.names = "NGT"
    )
}

# Handles both raw barcodes and the previously added PT_IDxx.<barcode>_PTxx form.
rename_dna_cell_barcodes <- function(dna_df, sample_id, suffix) {
    barcode <- rownames(dna_df)
    if (is.null(barcode)) stop("DNA data frame has no row names.")

    barcode <- sub("^PT_ID[0-9]+(?:_FU)?\\.", "", barcode)
    barcode <- sub("^PT[0-9]+(?:_FU)?\\.PT[0-9]+(?:_FU)?_", "", barcode)
    barcode <- sub("_(PT[0-9]+(?:FU)?)$", "", barcode)

    new_barcodes <- paste0(sample_id, ".", sample_id, "_", barcode, "_", suffix)

    if (anyDuplicated(new_barcodes)) {
        stop("Duplicate DNA barcodes detected after renaming for ", sample_id)
    }

    rownames(dna_df) <- new_barcodes
    dna_df
}

dna_samples <- setNames(
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(dna_manifest)), function(i) {
        df <- read_dna_data(dna_manifest$experiment[i], dna_manifest$donor[i])
        rename_dna_cell_barcodes(
            df, dna_manifest$sample_id[i], dna_manifest$suffix[i]
        )
    }),
    dna_manifest$sample_id
)

head(rownames(dna_samples[["PT01"]]))
# PT01.PT01_AACAATGCACCGTACGGA_PT01

# ---- Align columns across samples and merge -----------------------------------
all_dna_columns <- unique(unlist(lapply(dna_samples, colnames), use.names = FALSE))
all_dna_columns <- c("label", setdiff(all_dna_columns, "label"))  # "label" first

dna_samples_aligned <- lapply(dna_samples, function(df) {
    missing_columns <- setdiff(all_dna_columns, colnames(df))
    for (column_name in missing_columns) df[[column_name]] <- NA
    df[, all_dna_columns, drop = FALSE]
})

all_cell_barcodes <- unlist(lapply(dna_samples_aligned, rownames), use.names = FALSE)
if (anyDuplicated(all_cell_barcodes)) {
    stop("Duplicated DNA cell barcodes detected after alignment: ",
         paste(unique(all_cell_barcodes[duplicated(all_cell_barcodes)]), collapse = ", "))
}

# unname() prevents the sample_id from being added as a row-name prefix.
DNA_combined <- do.call(rbind, unname(dna_samples_aligned))

# "label" -> "Clone" throughout.
colnames(DNA_combined)[colnames(DNA_combined) == "label"] <- "Clone"

NON_WT_cells <- rownames(DNA_combined)[
    !is.na(DNA_combined$Clone) & DNA_combined$Clone != "WT"
]

# ---- 2. Chromosome-aware column ordering (for the CNA/structural-variant block) ----
chr_rank <- function(x) {
    chr <- sub("^chr([0-9]+|X|Y).*$", "\\1", x)
    out <- rep(NA_real_, length(chr))
    out[chr %in% as.character(1:22)] <- as.numeric(chr[chr %in% as.character(1:22)])
    out[chr == "X"] <- 23
    out[chr == "Y"] <- 24
    out
}

chr_name <- function(x) sub("^chr([0-9]+|X|Y).*$", "\\1", x)

cn <- colnames(DNA_combined)
meta_cols <- intersect(c("Clone", "sample_id"), cn)

whole_chr <- grep("^chr([0-9]+|X|Y)$", cn, value = TRUE)
arms      <- grep("^chr([0-9]+|X|Y)(p|q)$", cn, value = TRUE)
# Point-mutation columns are excluded entirely — genotypes already exist on
# `combined` from the curated-variant workflow, so only Clone + CNA/arm
# columns are carried forward from here.

chroms_present <- unique(chr_name(c(whole_chr, arms)))
chroms_present <- chroms_present[order(chr_rank(paste0("chr", chroms_present)))]

ordered_cols <- meta_cols
for (ch in chroms_present) {
    this_chr <- paste0("chr", ch)

    wc <- whole_chr[whole_chr == this_chr]

    this_arms <- arms[grepl(paste0("^", this_chr, "(p|q)$"), arms)]
    this_arms <- this_arms[order(sub(paste0("^", this_chr, "(p|q)$"), "\\1", this_arms))]

    ordered_cols <- c(ordered_cols, wc, this_arms)
}

# ---- 3. Keep Clone + CNA/structural-variant columns only -----------------------
cna_feature_cols <- c(whole_chr, arms)
cna_ordered_cols <- ordered_cols[ordered_cols %in% c(meta_cols, cna_feature_cols)]

all_aberr_cna_df <- DNA_combined[, cna_ordered_cols, drop = FALSE]

# A missing CNA call means no aberrancy was recorded for that region.
all_aberr_cna_df[, cna_feature_cols] <- lapply(
    all_aberr_cna_df[, cna_feature_cols, drop = FALSE],
    function(x) { x[is.na(x)] <- "WT"; x }
)

DNA_combined_CNV <- all_aberr_cna_df

dim(DNA_combined_CNV)
head(colnames(DNA_combined_CNV))

# ---- 4. Infer whole-chromosome events from matching p/q arm states, ------------
#         then reorder: metadata, whole chromosome, p arm, q arm
arm_cols  <- grep("^chr([0-9]+|X|Y)(p|q)$", colnames(all_aberr_cna_df), value = TRUE)
chr_names <- unique(sub("^(chr[0-9]+|chrX|chrY)(p|q)$", "\\1", arm_cols))

for (ch in chr_names) {
    p_col <- paste0(ch, "p")
    q_col <- paste0(ch, "q")

    if (!p_col %in% colnames(all_aberr_cna_df) ||
        !q_col %in% colnames(all_aberr_cna_df)) next
    if (ch %in% colnames(all_aberr_cna_df)) next  # don't overwrite an existing column

    p_vals <- as.character(all_aberr_cna_df[[p_col]])
    q_vals <- as.character(all_aberr_cna_df[[q_col]])

    whole_chr_state <- rep("WT", nrow(all_aberr_cna_df))
    whole_chr_state[p_vals == "Del"   & q_vals == "Del"]   <- "Monosomy"
    whole_chr_state[p_vals == "Amp"   & q_vals == "Amp"]   <- "Trisomy"
    whole_chr_state[p_vals == "cnLOH" & q_vals == "cnLOH"] <- "cnLOH"

    if (any(whole_chr_state != "WT")) {
        all_aberr_cna_df[[ch]] <- whole_chr_state
        message("Created ", ch, ": ",
                sum(whole_chr_state == "Monosomy"), " Monosomy, ",
                sum(whole_chr_state == "Trisomy"), " Trisomy, ",
                sum(whole_chr_state == "cnLOH"), " cnLOH")
    }
}

cn <- colnames(all_aberr_cna_df)
meta_cols <- intersect(c("Clone", "sample_id"), cn)

whole_chr_cols <- grep("^chr([0-9]+|X|Y)$", cn, value = TRUE)
arm_cols       <- grep("^chr([0-9]+|X|Y)(p|q)$", cn, value = TRUE)

chromosomes <- unique(sub("^chr([0-9]+|X|Y).*$", "\\1", c(whole_chr_cols, arm_cols)))
chromosomes <- chromosomes[order(chr_rank(paste0("chr", chromosomes)))]

ordered_cna_cols <- meta_cols
for (ch in chromosomes) {
    chrom <- paste0("chr", ch)
    ordered_cna_cols <- c(
        ordered_cna_cols,
        intersect(chrom, whole_chr_cols),
        intersect(paste0(chrom, "p"), arm_cols),
        intersect(paste0(chrom, "q"), arm_cols)
    )
}

all_aberr_cna_df <- all_aberr_cna_df[, ordered_cna_cols, drop = FALSE]

# ---- 5. Align to combined's Seurat cell names ----------------------------------
# Key: <single-cell barcode> + <terminal sample tag>, e.g.
# PT02.PT02_AACAACTGGGGTAGACAT_PT02  and  PT_ID02.AACAACTGGGGTAGACAT_PT02
# both map to AACAACTGGGGTAGACAT__PT02.
make_cell_key <- function(cell_names) {
    key <- sub("^.*(?:\\.|_)([^._]+)_(PT[0-9]+(?:FU)?)$", "\\1__\\2", cell_names, perl = TRUE)
    valid <- grepl("^.*(?:\\.|_)[^._]+_(PT[0-9]+(?:FU)?)$", cell_names, perl = TRUE)
    key[!valid] <- NA_character_
    key
}

align_dna_rownames_to_seurat <- function(dna_df, seurat_cells) {
    dna_keys    <- make_cell_key(rownames(dna_df))
    seurat_keys <- make_cell_key(seurat_cells)

    if (anyNA(dna_keys))    stop("Could not parse ", sum(is.na(dna_keys)), " DNA cell names.")
    if (anyNA(seurat_keys)) stop("Could not parse ", sum(is.na(seurat_keys)), " Seurat cell names.")
    if (anyDuplicated(dna_keys))    stop("Duplicated DNA barcode/sample keys detected.")
    if (anyDuplicated(seurat_keys)) stop("Duplicated Seurat barcode/sample keys detected.")

    seurat_name_lookup   <- setNames(seurat_cells, seurat_keys)
    matched_seurat_names <- unname(seurat_name_lookup[dna_keys])
    matched_idx          <- !is.na(matched_seurat_names)

    new_dna_names <- rownames(dna_df)
    new_dna_names[matched_idx] <- matched_seurat_names[matched_idx]

    if (anyDuplicated(new_dna_names)) stop("Duplicate DNA row names created during alignment.")

    rownames(dna_df) <- new_dna_names
    attr(dna_df, "n_matched_to_seurat")   <- sum(matched_idx)
    attr(dna_df, "n_unmatched_to_seurat") <- sum(!matched_idx)
    dna_df
}

all_aberr_cna_df <- align_dna_rownames_to_seurat(all_aberr_cna_df, colnames(combined))

message("CNA rows matched: ", attr(all_aberr_cna_df, "n_matched_to_seurat"),
        " / ", nrow(all_aberr_cna_df))

sum(rownames(all_aberr_cna_df) %in% colnames(combined))

# ---- 6. Attach Clone + CNA columns to combined (no subsetting) -----------------
# `combined` retains every cell; only cells with a matched DNA row get real
# values in the new columns, everything else stays NA. Subsetting to
# DNA-matched cells is deferred to whatever downstream step needs it.
matched <- rownames(all_aberr_cna_df) %in% colnames(combined)
all_aberr_cna_df_matched <- all_aberr_cna_df[matched, , drop = FALSE]

message("Cells with matched CNA metadata: ", sum(matched),
        " / ", length(matched), " (", sum(!matched), " unmatched, left as NA)")

attach_cols <- setdiff(colnames(all_aberr_cna_df_matched), "sample_id")

for (col_name in attach_cols) {
    combined@meta.data[[col_name]] <- NA
    combined@meta.data[rownames(all_aberr_cna_df_matched), col_name] <-
        all_aberr_cna_df_matched[[col_name]]
}

cat("Added", length(attach_cols), "column(s) to combined metadata:\n")
print(attach_cols)

# combined still has ncol(combined) cells — unchanged.
ncol(combined)
```

# 6. Add TP53 Status

```{r}
# ============================================================
# TP53_Status on combined_dna_pro (standalone)
# ============================================================
# Both the curated TP53/other variant genotypes (section 4) and the
# CNA/structural-variant columns (section "Loading clonal and CNA data") were
# attached directly to combined@meta.data — there is no separate DNA data
# frame left to intersect against. "DNA-matched" here means cells with at
# least one non-NA curated variant genotype, i.e. combined$TP53 is not NA.
stopifnot(exists("combined"))
tp53_cols <- grep("^TP53_", colnames(combined@meta.data), value = TRUE)
tp53_cols <- setdiff(tp53_cols, c("TP53_Status", "TP53_Het_count", "TP53_Hem_flag"))
if (length(tp53_cols) == 0) {
    stop("No TP53 protein-level mutation columns were found. Run the ",
         "variant-metadata-attachment step (section 4) first.")
}
# ---- Subset to cells with matched DNA (curated variant) metadata --------------
Idents(combined) <- combined$Celltype_revised_refined
common_cells <- colnames(combined)[!is.na(combined$TP53)]
message("Cells in combined Seurat object: ", ncol(combined))
message("Cells with matched DNA metadata: ", length(common_cells))
combined_dna_pro <- subset(combined, cells = common_cells)
table(combined_dna_pro$IPSS_M, useNA = "ifany")

# ---- Derive TP53_Status ---------------------------------------------------------
# TP53_<label> columns are named like TP53_R175H_..., with
# 0 = WT, 1 = HET, 2 = HOM/HEM (per the curated-variant NGT convention).
#
# Multi-Hit  = >=2 distinct HET variants, OR any HOM/HEM call
# Single-Hit = exactly one HET variant and no HOM/HEM call
# WT         = no called variant at all
# (Complex karyotype (CK) is retained as its own annotation column but no
# longer promotes a lone het to Multi-Hit.)
tp53_mat <- as.matrix(combined_dna_pro@meta.data[, tp53_cols, drop = FALSE])
suppressWarnings(storage.mode(tp53_mat) <- "numeric")
tp53_het_count <- rowSums(!is.na(tp53_mat) & tp53_mat == 1)
tp53_hem_flag  <- rowSums(!is.na(tp53_mat) & tp53_mat >= 2) > 0

combined_dna_pro$TP53_Status <- ifelse(
    tp53_hem_flag | tp53_het_count >= 2,
    "Multi-Hit",
    ifelse(tp53_het_count == 1, "Single-Hit", "WT")
)
combined_dna_pro$TP53_Status <- factor(
    combined_dna_pro$TP53_Status,
    levels = c("WT", "Single-Hit", "Multi-Hit")
)
table(combined_dna_pro$TP53_Status, useNA = "ifany")
table(combined_dna_pro$TP53_Status, combined_dna_pro$WHO, useNA = "ifany")
```

# 8. Investigating co-mutations

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Per-sample clonal heatmap: VAF-by-clone + CNA-by-clone panels
# ============================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(scales)
  library(grid)
})

# ---- Column identification --------------------------------------------------
get_variant_cols <- function(meta) grep("_c\\.", colnames(meta), value = TRUE)
get_chr_cols     <- function(meta) grep("^chr([0-9]+|X|Y)(p|q)?$", colnames(meta), value = TRUE)

# ---- Chromosome ordering helpers ---------------------------------------------
# Numeric sort key for chr1..chr22, chrX, chrY.
chr_rank <- function(chr_name) {
    n <- sub("^chr", "", chr_name)
    out <- rep(NA_real_, length(n))
    is_num <- grepl("^[0-9]+$", n)
    out[is_num] <- as.numeric(n[is_num])
    out[n == "X"] <- 23
    out[n == "Y"] <- 24
    out
}

# Base chromosome name (drops trailing p/q) and arm suffix, for grouping and
# within-group ordering (whole chr, then p, then q).
chr_base <- function(col_names) sub("^(chr([0-9]+|X|Y))(p|q)?$", "\\1", col_names)
chr_arm  <- function(col_names) {
    arm <- sub("^chr([0-9]+|X|Y)(p|q)?$", "\\2", col_names)
    factor(arm, levels = c("", "p", "q"))  # whole chr first, then p, then q
}

# Order a vector of chr/arm column names by chromosome, then whole/p/q.
order_chr_cols <- function(cols) {
    base <- chr_base(cols)
    arm  <- chr_arm(cols)
    cols[order(chr_rank(base), arm)]
}

# ---- Helpers ------------------------------------------------------------------
get_mode <- function(x) {
    x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
    if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    ux <- unique(x)
    ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

# Genotype columns may come back as factor/character (e.g. after alignment
# steps that filled missing columns with NA of a different type) rather than
# numeric — coerce safely so 1/2 comparisons don't silently fail.
as_numeric_geno <- function(x) {
    if (is.factor(x)) x <- as.character(x)
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

discrete_colors <- function(levels, palette = NULL) {
    levels <- unique(levels[!is.na(levels)])
    if (is.null(palette)) return(setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(levels)), levels))
    if (!is.null(names(palette))) {
        missing <- setdiff(levels, names(palette))
        if (length(missing) > 0) {
            palette <- c(palette, setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(missing)), missing))
        }
        return(palette[levels])
    }
    setNames(palette[seq_along(levels)], levels)
}

# Wrap a long "_"-delimited label onto two lines, breaking at whichever
# underscore lands closest to the string's midpoint. Labels with no
# underscore (or too short to bother) are left as-is. Display-only — never
# apply this to the vector used for matching/indexing.
wrap_label_two_lines <- function(x, sep = "_", min_len = 15) {
    vapply(x, function(lbl) {
        if (is.na(lbl) || nchar(lbl) < min_len) return(lbl)
        parts <- strsplit(lbl, sep, fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
        if (length(parts) <= 1) return(lbl)
        cum_len  <- cumsum(nchar(parts) + 1)  # +1 accounts for the separator
        target   <- utils::tail(cum_len, 1) / 2
        split_at <- which.min(abs(cum_len - target))
        split_at <- min(max(split_at, 1), length(parts) - 1)
        line1 <- paste(parts[seq_len(split_at)], collapse = sep)
        line2 <- paste(parts[(split_at + 1):length(parts)], collapse = sep)
        paste(line1, line2, sep = "\n")
    }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

clone_vaf_matrix <- function(sub_meta, clones, variant_cols) {
    mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(clones), ncol = length(variant_cols),
                  dimnames = list(clones, variant_cols))
    for (cl in clones) {
        cells <- rownames(sub_meta)[sub_meta$Clone == cl & !is.na(sub_meta$Clone)]
        if (length(cells) == 0) next
        g <- sub_meta[cells, variant_cols, drop = FALSE]
        g <- as.matrix(as.data.frame(lapply(g, as_numeric_geno)))
        n_wt  <- colSums(g == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
        n_het <- colSums(g == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
        n_hom <- colSums(g == 2, na.rm = TRUE)
        n_gt  <- n_wt + n_het + n_hom
        mat[cl, ] <- ifelse(n_gt > 0, (n_het + 2 * n_hom) / (2 * n_gt), NA_real_)
    }
    mat
}

clone_cna_matrix <- function(sub_meta, clones, chr_cols) {
    mat <- matrix(NA_character_, nrow = length(clones), ncol = length(chr_cols),
                  dimnames = list(clones, chr_cols))
    for (cl in clones) {
        cells <- rownames(sub_meta)[sub_meta$Clone == cl & !is.na(sub_meta$Clone)]
        if (length(cells) == 0) next
        for (cc in chr_cols) mat[cl, cc] <- get_mode(as.character(sub_meta[cells, cc]))
    }
    mat
}

# ---- Main per-sample plotting function ----------------------------------------
plot_sample_clonal_heatmap <- function(seurat_obj, sample_id,
                                        sample_col = "Sample",
                                        min_clone_cells = 5,
                                        file = NULL) {
    meta <- seurat_obj@meta.data
    variant_cols <- get_variant_cols(meta)
    chr_cols     <- get_chr_cols(meta)

    sub_meta <- meta[meta[[sample_col]] == sample_id & !is.na(meta[[sample_col]]), , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(sub_meta) == 0) stop("No cells found for sample: ", sample_id)

    relevant_variants <- variant_cols[
        vapply(variant_cols, function(v) {
            any(as_numeric_geno(sub_meta[[v]]) %in% c(1, 2), na.rm = TRUE)
        }, logical(1))
    ]
    if (length(relevant_variants) == 0) {
        message("No mutant variants found for ", sample_id, " — skipping."); return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    relevant_chr <- chr_cols[
        vapply(chr_cols, function(cc) any(!sub_meta[[cc]] %in% c("WT", NA), na.rm = TRUE), logical(1))
    ]
    # Order chromosome/arm columns chromosome-by-chromosome (whole chr, then
    # p, then q) so each chromosome forms one contiguous panel.
    relevant_chr <- order_chr_cols(relevant_chr)

    clone_tab <- sort(table(sub_meta$Clone[!is.na(sub_meta$Clone)]), decreasing = TRUE)

    # Total cells with a clone assignment in this sample — the denominator
    # for relative clone size.
    n_total_annotated <- sum(clone_tab)

    clones <- names(clone_tab)[clone_tab >= min_clone_cells]
    if ("WT" %in% clones) clones <- c("WT", setdiff(clones, "WT"))
    if (length(clones) == 0) {
        message("No clone with >= ", min_clone_cells, " cells for ", sample_id, " — skipping."); return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    vaf_mat <- clone_vaf_matrix(sub_meta, clones, relevant_variants)
    cna_mat <- if (length(relevant_chr) > 0) clone_cna_matrix(sub_meta, clones, relevant_chr) else NULL

    # ---- Row (clone-level) clinical annotation ---------------------------------
    clone_meta <- do.call(rbind, lapply(clones, function(cl) {
        cells <- rownames(sub_meta)[sub_meta$Clone == cl & !is.na(sub_meta$Clone)]
        data.frame(
            Clone       = cl,
            n_cells     = length(cells),
            TP53_Status = get_mode(as.character(sub_meta[cells, "TP53_Status"])),
            IPSS_M      = get_mode(as.character(sub_meta[cells, "IPSS_M"])),
            WHO         = get_mode(as.character(sub_meta[cells, "WHO"])),
            ICC         = get_mode(as.character(sub_meta[cells, "ICC"])),
            CK          = get_mode(as.character(sub_meta[cells, "CK"])),
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
    }))
    rownames(clone_meta) <- clone_meta$Clone
    clone_meta <- clone_meta[clones, ]

    # Relative clone size vs. total clone-annotated cells in the sample,
    # formatted "n (XX.X%)".
    clone_meta$pct_of_annotated <- 100 * clone_meta$n_cells / n_total_annotated
    clone_meta$size_label <- sprintf(
        "%d (%.1f%%)", clone_meta$n_cells, clone_meta$pct_of_annotated
    )

    ann_colors <- list(
        TP53_Status = discrete_colors(clone_meta$TP53_Status,
                        c("WT" = "grey80", "Single-Hit" = "orange", "Multi-Hit" = "firebrick")),
        IPSS_M = discrete_colors(clone_meta$IPSS_M),
        WHO    = discrete_colors(clone_meta$WHO),
        ICC    = discrete_colors(clone_meta$ICC),
        CK     = discrete_colors(clone_meta$CK, c("Yes" = "black", "No" = "grey90"))
    )

    row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
        TP53_Status = clone_meta$TP53_Status,
        IPSS_M      = clone_meta$IPSS_M,
        WHO         = clone_meta$WHO,
        ICC         = clone_meta$ICC,
        CK          = clone_meta$CK,
        n_cells     = anno_barplot(clone_meta$n_cells, width = unit(1.5, "cm")),
        `n (%)`     = anno_text(
            clone_meta$size_label,
            gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
            just = "left",
            location = unit(0, "npc")
        ),
        col = ann_colors,
        annotation_name_side = "top",
        annotation_name_rot = 45,
        annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
        simple_anno_size = unit(3, "mm")
    )

    vaf_col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 1), c("white", "orange", "firebrick"))

    # Display-only wrapped labels (matrices/annotations above still keyed on
    # the original unwrapped `clones` / column names).
    vaf_mat_display <- vaf_mat
    rownames(vaf_mat_display) <- wrap_label_two_lines(rownames(vaf_mat))
    colnames(vaf_mat_display) <- wrap_label_two_lines(colnames(vaf_mat))

    ht_vaf <- Heatmap(
        vaf_mat_display, name = "VAF", col = vaf_col_fun,
        cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
        row_names_side = "left", column_title = "Variants (VAF)",
        column_names_rot = 45,
        column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7, lineheight = 0.85),
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, lineheight = 0.85),
        na_col = "grey90",
        left_annotation = row_anno,
        row_names_max_width = unit(6, "cm"),
        column_names_max_height = unit(5, "cm")
    )

    ht_list <- ht_vaf

    if (!is.null(cna_mat) && ncol(cna_mat) > 0) {
        cna_mat_display <- cna_mat
        colnames(cna_mat_display) <- wrap_label_two_lines(colnames(cna_mat))

        # One panel per chromosome: split columns by base chromosome, in
        # chromosome-numeric order, with a small gap between panels.
        chr_group <- chr_base(colnames(cna_mat))
        chr_group_levels <- unique(chr_group)  # already chr-ordered via order_chr_cols()
        chr_group <- factor(chr_group, levels = chr_group_levels)

        cna_levels <- unique(as.vector(cna_mat))
        cna_colors <- discrete_colors(cna_levels, c(
            "WT" = "grey95", "Del" = "steelblue", "Amp" = "firebrick",
            "cnLOH" = "purple", "Monosomy" = "darkblue", "Trisomy" = "darkred"
        ))
        ht_cna <- Heatmap(
            cna_mat_display, name = "CNA", col = cna_colors,
            cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
            cluster_column_slices = FALSE,
            column_split = chr_group,
            column_gap = unit(1.5, "mm"),
            column_title = "%s",
            column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold"),
            column_title_rot = 0,
            show_row_names = FALSE,
            column_names_rot = 45,
            column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7, lineheight = 0.85),
            na_col = "white",
            column_names_max_height = unit(5, "cm")
        )
        ht_list <- ht_list + ht_cna
    }

    draw(
        ht_list,
        column_title = sample_id,
        merge_legend = TRUE,
        heatmap_legend_side = "right",
        annotation_legend_side = "right",
        padding = unit(c(2, 2, 8, 2), "mm")
    )

    invisible(ht_list)
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# HTO-positive barcodes for PT19/PT20 (whole/unfractionated MNCs)
# ============================================================
PT19_whole_mncs_barcodes <- read.csv('/project/meadlab/shared/02__Projects/02b__Tapestri/resources/HTO_barcodes/PT19_MDS011_HTO_positive_barcodes.csv')$barcode
PT19_whole_mncs_barcodes <- paste0('PT_ID19.', PT19_whole_mncs_barcodes, '_PT19')

PT20_whole_mncs_barcodes <- read.csv('/project/meadlab/shared/02__Projects/02b__Tapestri/resources/HTO_barcodes/PT20_pMDS001_HTO_positive_barcodes.csv')$barcode
PT20_whole_mncs_barcodes <- paste0('PT_ID20.', PT20_whole_mncs_barcodes, '_PT20')

# Verify the constructed names actually exist in combined_dna_pro_no_ngt before using
# them for subset() — Seurat's subset() silently drops unmatched cell names
# rather than erroring, so a barcode-format mismatch (e.g. 'PT_ID19.<bc>_PT19'
# vs the 'PT19.PT19_<bc>_PT19' form used elsewhere in this pipeline) would
# otherwise pass unnoticed and quietly exclude these patients' HTO+ cells.
n_pt19_matched <- sum(PT19_whole_mncs_barcodes %in% colnames(combined_dna_pro_no_ngt))
n_pt20_matched <- sum(PT20_whole_mncs_barcodes %in% colnames(combined_dna_pro_no_ngt))

message("PT19 HTO+ barcodes matched: ", n_pt19_matched, " / ", length(PT19_whole_mncs_barcodes))
message("PT20 HTO+ barcodes matched: ", n_pt20_matched, " / ", length(PT20_whole_mncs_barcodes))

if (n_pt19_matched == 0 || n_pt20_matched == 0) {
    stop(
        "None of the constructed PT19/PT20 barcodes matched colnames(combined_dna_pro_no_ngt). ",
        "Example expected: ", PT19_whole_mncs_barcodes[1],
        " | example actual colname: ", grep("PT19", colnames(combined_dna_pro_no_ngt), value = TRUE)[1],
        ". The barcode-construction format (prefix/suffix) likely needs to be ",
        "changed to match combined_dna_pro_no_ngt's actual naming convention."
    )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Build the Milo object
# ============================================================
library(miloR)
library(SingleCellExperiment)

# LayerData() rather than @counts/@data: robust if this Seurat object (or any
# ancestor it was subset from) has been converted to the Assay5 structure,
# where @counts can silently return something other than what's expected.
adt_counts <- LayerData(combined_dna_pro_no_ngt_bm_mncs_unfractionated, assay = "ADT", layer = "counts")
adt_data   <- LayerData(combined_dna_pro_no_ngt_bm_mncs_unfractionated, assay = "ADT", layer = "data")

set.seed(123)
SCE_bm_MNCs <- SingleCellExperiment(
    assays = list(counts = adt_counts, logcounts = adt_data),
    colData = combined_dna_pro_no_ngt_bm_mncs_unfractionated@meta.data,
    reducedDims = SimpleList(
        PCA  = combined_dna_pro_no_ngt_bm_mncs_unfractionated@reductions$harmony@cell.embeddings,
        UMAP = combined_dna_pro_no_ngt_bm_mncs_unfractionated@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings
    )
)

BM_MNCs_milo <- Milo(SCE_bm_MNCs)
BM_MNCs_milo
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Neighbourhoods, counting, distances
# ============================================================
BM_MNCs_milo <- buildGraph(BM_MNCs_milo, k = 20, d = 15, reduced.dim = "PCA")
BM_MNCs_milo <- makeNhoods(BM_MNCs_milo, prop = 0.20, k = 20, d = 15,
                           refined = TRUE, reduced_dims = "PCA")

plotNhoodSizeHist(BM_MNCs_milo)
```

```{r}
# Composite per-donor-per-genotype sample ID: WT and MUT cells from the same
# patient are treated as separate "samples" for this within-patient clonal
# abundance comparison.
colData(BM_MNCs_milo)$Donor_TP53 <- paste0(
    colData(BM_MNCs_milo)$Donor, "_",
    colData(BM_MNCs_milo)$TP53
)

BM_MNCs_milo <- countCells(
    BM_MNCs_milo,
    meta.data = as.data.frame(colData(BM_MNCs_milo)),
    sample = "Donor_TP53"
)

BM_MNCs_milo <- calcNhoodDistance(BM_MNCs_milo, d = 15, reduced.dim = "PCA")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Design matrix — Donor now actually enters the model
# ============================================================
BM_MNCs_design <- data.frame(colData(BM_MNCs_milo))[, c("Donor_TP53", "Donor", "TP53")]

# Keep Donor_TP53 as the composite — do NOT overwrite it with Donor
BM_MNCs_design <- BM_MNCs_design[!duplicated(BM_MNCs_design$Donor_TP53), ]
rownames(BM_MNCs_design) <- BM_MNCs_design$Donor_TP53

BM_MNCs_design$TP53  <- factor(BM_MNCs_design$TP53, levels = c("WT", "MUT"))
BM_MNCs_design$Donor <- factor(BM_MNCs_design$Donor)

# Align design rows to the count-matrix columns explicitly (robust against ordering)
BM_MNCs_design <- BM_MNCs_design[colnames(nhoodCounts(BM_MNCs_milo)), , drop = FALSE]

# Check the design is a complete WT/MUT-per-donor layout before fitting
# ~ Donor + TP53 — an incomplete/unbalanced design can make that formula
# non-estimable (aliased coefficients) rather than simply less powerful.
print(table(BM_MNCs_design$Donor, BM_MNCs_design$TP53))

# ---- Test, blocking on Donor -----------------------------------------------
# The previous formula (~ TP53 alone) let between-patient composition
# differences leak into the TP53 effect estimate, since Donor was prepared in
# the design but never included. Donor is now a covariate.
da_results <- testNhoods(
    BM_MNCs_milo,
    design = ~ TP53,
    design.df = BM_MNCs_design,
    reduced.dim = "PCA",
    fdr.weighting = "graph-overlap"
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Annotate neighbourhoods and order cell types
# ============================================================
da_results <- annotateNhoods(
    BM_MNCs_milo, da_results, coldata_col = "Celltype_revised_refined"
)

da_results$Celltype_revised_refined <- factor(
```

```{r}
    filter(!is.na(SpatialFDR), SpatialFDR < alpha, !is.na(logFC)) %>%
    group_by(group_by) %>%
    summarise(
        pos   = sum(logFC > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        neg   = sum(logFC < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        zero  = sum(logFC == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_sig = dplyr::n(),
        .groups = "drop"

group_levels_all <- da.res %>% distinct(group_by)
rank_table <- group_levels_all %>%
    left_join(sig_counts, by = "group_by") %>%
    mutate(across(c(pos, neg, zero, n_sig, diff), ~ tidyr::replace_na(., 0))) %>%
    arrange(desc(diff), desc(n_sig), group_by)

ordered_levels <- rev(rank_table$group_by)
da.res <- da.res %>%
    mutate(
        group_by     = factor(group_by, levels = ordered_levels, ordered = TRUE),
        is_expanded  = SpatialFDR < alpha,
        logFC_color  = ifelse(is_expanded, logFC, NA_real_)
    )

BM_MNCs_plot <-
    ggplot(
```

# 10. Bulk to single cell VAFs correlation

Calculate single cell VAFs

```{r}
# ============================================================
# scVAF per curated variant, computed directly from DNA_variants_combined
# (the per-cell genotype matrix already built in section 4) — no
# lymphoid/non-lymphoid split, no meta.data lookups.
# ============================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

stopifnot(exists("DNA_variants_combined"), exists("combined_dna_pro"))

# ---- 1. Resolve each curated_variants row to a DNA_variants_combined column ---
escape_regex <- function(x) {
    special <- c("\\", ".", "^", "$", "|", "(", ")", "[", "]", "{", "}", "*", "+", "?")
    for (s in special) x <- gsub(s, paste0("\\", s), x, fixed = TRUE)
    x
}

resolve_variant_column <- function(cols, gene, cdna) {
    pattern <- paste0("^", escape_regex(gene), "_", escape_regex(cdna), "_")
    hit <- grep(pattern, cols, value = TRUE)
    if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    if (length(hit) > 1) {
        warning("Multiple columns matched ", gene, "_", cdna, ": ",
                paste(hit, collapse = ", "), " — using the first.")
    }
    hit[1]
}

variant_cols_available <- colnames(DNA_variants_combined)

curated_variants$matched_column <- mapply(
    function(g, c) resolve_variant_column(variant_cols_available, g, c),
    curated_variants$gene, curated_variants$cdna
)

cat("Curated variants matched to DNA_variants_combined columns:",
    sum(!is.na(curated_variants$matched_column)), "/", nrow(curated_variants), "\n")

unmatched <- curated_variants[
    is.na(curated_variants$matched_column), c("sample_id", "gene", "cdna", "aa_change")
]
if (nrow(unmatched) > 0) {
    cat("\nUnmatched (not in DNA_variants_combined):\n")
    print(unmatched, row.names = FALSE)
}

# ---- 2. Resolve each curated sample_id to combined_dna_pro's Sample values ----
sample_ids_in_object <- unique(na.omit(combined_dna_pro$Sample))

resolve_sample_id <- function(sample_id, available) {
    if (sample_id %in% available) return(sample_id)
    alt <- gsub("_FU$", "FU", sample_id)
    if (alt %in% available) return(alt)
    NA_character_
}

curated_variants$resolved_sample_id <- vapply(
    curated_variants$sample_id, resolve_sample_id, character(1),
    available = sample_ids_in_object
)

cat("\nCurated sample_ids matched to combined_dna_pro$Sample:",
    sum(!is.na(curated_variants$resolved_sample_id)), "/", nrow(curated_variants), "\n")

# ---- 3. Per-sample cell name lookup (once) -------------------------------------
sample_cell_lookup <- split(
    colnames(combined_dna_pro),
    combined_dna_pro@meta.data$Sample
)

# ---- 4. Compute scVAF for each curated variant, from DNA_variants_combined -----
compute_scvaf_from_matrix <- function(mat, sample_id, col_name, sample_cells) {
    empty <- data.frame(
        matched_column = col_name, match_type = NA_character_,
        n_cells = NA_integer_, n_genotyped = NA_integer_,
        pct_genotyped = NA_real_, n_WT = NA_integer_, n_HET = NA_integer_,
        n_HOM = NA_integer_, n_missing = NA_integer_, VAF = NA_real_,
        mutant_cell_fraction = NA_real_, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    if (is.na(sample_id) || is.na(col_name) || is.null(sample_cells)) {
        empty$match_type <- "none"
        return(empty)
    }

    cells_in_matrix <- intersect(sample_cells, rownames(mat))
    n_cells <- length(cells_in_matrix)
    if (n_cells == 0) {
        empty$match_type <- "no_cells"
        empty$n_cells <- 0L
        return(empty)
    }

    g <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(mat[cells_in_matrix, col_name]))

    n_wt  <- sum(g == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_het <- sum(g == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_hom <- sum(g == 2, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_genotyped <- n_wt + n_het + n_hom

    mut_alleles <- n_het + 2 * n_hom
    total_alleles <- 2 * n_genotyped
    vaf <- if (total_alleles > 0) 100 * mut_alleles / total_alleles else NA_real_
    mut_cell_frac <- if (n_genotyped > 0) (n_het + n_hom) / n_genotyped else NA_real_

    data.frame(
        matched_column = col_name, match_type = "exact",
        n_cells = n_cells, n_genotyped = as.integer(n_genotyped),
        pct_genotyped = round(100 * n_genotyped / n_cells, 1),
        n_WT = as.integer(n_wt), n_HET = as.integer(n_het), n_HOM = as.integer(n_hom),
        n_missing = as.integer(n_cells - n_genotyped),
        VAF = vaf, mutant_cell_fraction = mut_cell_frac,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
}

vaf_columns <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(curated_variants)), function(i) {
    sid <- curated_variants$resolved_sample_id[i]
    compute_scvaf_from_matrix(
        DNA_variants_combined, sid,
        curated_variants$matched_column[i],
        sample_cell_lookup[[sid]]
    )
}))

curated_variants_vaf <- cbind(curated_variants, vaf_columns)

# cbind() duplicates matched_column (present in both curated_variants and
# vaf_columns); keep only the first occurrence of any repeated name.
curated_variants_vaf <- curated_variants_vaf[, !duplicated(colnames(curated_variants_vaf))]
rownames(curated_variants_vaf) <- NULL

curated_variants_vaf$Recovered_here <- ifelse(
    is.na(curated_variants_vaf$matched_column) | is.na(curated_variants_vaf$VAF),
    "No", "Yes"
)
curated_variants_vaf$estimable <- !is.na(curated_variants_vaf$n_genotyped) &
    curated_variants_vaf$n_genotyped >= 10

cat("\n=====================================================\n")
cat("scVAF per curated variant (from DNA_variants_combined)\n")
cat("=====================================================\n")
print(
    curated_variants_vaf[, c("sample_id", "gene", "cdna", "aa_change",
                              "Recovered_here", "n_cells", "n_genotyped",
                              "pct_genotyped", "n_WT", "n_HET", "n_HOM",
                              "VAF", "mutant_cell_fraction",
                              "match_type", "estimable")],
    row.names = FALSE, digits = 3
)
```

Preparing data for plotting

```{r}
# ---- Build the merged scVAF/bulkVAF table --------------------------------------
build_selected_columns <- function(vaf_table) {
    out <- vaf_table[!grepl("_FU$", vaf_table$sample_id),
                      c("sample_id", "gene", "cdna", "aa_change", "VAF")]
    rownames(out) <- NULL
    names(out)[names(out) == "VAF"] <- "scVAF"

    out$variant_label <- paste0(
        out$gene, "_", out$cdna,
        ifelse(is.na(out$aa_change), "", paste0("_p.", out$aa_change))
    )

    curated_keys <- paste(out$sample_id, out$variant_label)

    orphaned <- bulk_vaf_table[!bulk_keys %in% curated_keys, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(orphaned) > 0) {
        stop(
            "Bulk entries with no matching curated row:\n",
            paste(orphaned$sample_id, orphaned$variant_label, collapse = "\n")
        )
    }

    out$bulkVAF <- bulk_vaf_table$bulkVAF[match(curated_keys, bulk_keys)]

    out[, c("sample_id", "variant_label", "gene", "cdna", "aa_change",
            "scVAF", "bulkVAF")]
}

curated_vaf <- build_selected_columns(curated_variants_vaf)
```

Plotting

```{r}
# ---- Linear regression + scatter plot ------------------------------------------
# Regression fit is calculated on "Both" (variants detected in both bulk and
# single-cell) only; the scatter plot itself shows every detected point
# (Both / scDNA only / Bulk only).
excluded_genes <- c("SETBP1")

detection_colours <- c(
    "Both"       = "#4D4D4D",
    "scDNA only" = "#009E73",
    "Bulk only"  = "#0072B2"
)

save_dir <- "/project/meadlab/shared/02__Projects/02b__Tapestri/results/figures"
dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

build_vaf_scatter <- function(vaf_table, y_axis_label, set_label) {
    # curated_vaf already excludes _FU samples, but this filter is kept so the
    # function is safe to call on any similarly-shaped table.
    vaf_plot_df <- vaf_table %>%
        filter(!grepl("_FU$", sample_id), !gene %in% excluded_genes) %>%
        mutate(
            detected_sc = !is.na(scVAF),
            detected_bulk = !is.na(bulkVAF),
            scVAF_plot = ifelse(is.na(scVAF), 0, scVAF),
            bulkVAF_plot = ifelse(is.na(bulkVAF), 0, bulkVAF),
            detection = case_when(
                detected_sc & detected_bulk ~ "Both",
                detected_sc & !detected_bulk ~ "scDNA only",
                !detected_sc & detected_bulk ~ "Bulk only",
                TRUE ~ "Neither"
            )
        ) %>%
        filter(detection != "Neither") %>%
        mutate(row_id = row_number())

    cat("\n[", set_label, "] points by detection category:\n", sep = "")
    print(table(vaf_plot_df$detection))

    # ---- Regression: "Both" only ---------------------------------------------
    shared <- vaf_plot_df %>% filter(detection == "Both")
    fit <- lm(scVAF ~ bulkVAF, data = shared)
    fit_summary <- summary(fit)
    r2 <- fit_summary$r.squared
    p_value <- fit_summary$coefficients["bulkVAF", "Pr(>|t|)"]

    residual_cols <- shared %>%
        mutate(
            fitted = as.numeric(fitted(fit)),
            residual = as.numeric(residuals(fit)),
            residual_stud = as.numeric(rstudent(fit))
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(row_id, fitted, residual, residual_stud)

    # Join residuals back onto the full plotting table — scDNA-only / Bulk-only
    # rows simply get NA for fitted/residual, since they never entered the fit.
    vaf_plot_df <- vaf_plot_df %>% left_join(residual_cols, by = "row_id")

    residual_df <- vaf_plot_df %>%
        filter(detection == "Both") %>%
        mutate(cell_set = set_label) %>%
        dplyr::select(
            cell_set, dplyr::any_of(c("sample_id", "gene", "variant", "id")),
            bulkVAF, scVAF, residual, residual_stud
        ) %>%
        arrange(desc(abs(residual_stud)))

    cat(
        "Linear fit on", nrow(shared), "shared variants:",
        "R2 =", round(r2, 3),
        "| slope =", round(coef(fit)["bulkVAF"], 3),
        "| p =", format.pval(p_value, digits = 3),
        "| Spearman rho =",
        round(cor(shared$scVAF, shared$bulkVAF, method = "spearman"), 3),
        "| residual SD =", round(fit_summary$sigma, 3), "\n"
    )

    write.csv(
        residual_df,
        file.path(save_dir, paste0("scVAF_vs_bulkVAF_residuals_", set_label, ".csv")),
        row.names = FALSE
    )

    label_text <- paste0(
        "R\u00b2 = ", format(round(r2, 3), nsmall = 3), "\n",
        "p = ",
        if (p_value < 0.0001) format(p_value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
        else format(round(p_value, 4), nsmall = 4),
        "\nn = ", nrow(shared)
    )

    # ---- Plot: all detected points (Both / scDNA only / Bulk only) -----------
    axis_max <- max(c(vaf_plot_df$scVAF_plot, vaf_plot_df$bulkVAF_plot), na.rm = TRUE)
    axis_limit <- ceiling(axis_max / 10) * 10
    marker_radius <- axis_limit * 0.0135
    border_width <- 0.6

    circle_polygon <- function(x, y, r, id, n = 90) {
        theta <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n)
        data.frame(x = x + r * cos(theta), y = y + r * sin(theta), marker_id = id)
    }

    marker_polygons <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(vaf_plot_df)), function(i) {
        poly <- circle_polygon(
            vaf_plot_df$bulkVAF_plot[i], vaf_plot_df$scVAF_plot[i],
            marker_radius, id = i
        )
        poly$detection <- vaf_plot_df$detection[i]
        poly
    }))

    draw_order <- order(-vaf_plot_df$scVAF_plot)
    marker_polygons$marker_id <- factor(marker_polygons$marker_id, levels = draw_order)

    poly_both <- marker_polygons %>% filter(detection == "Both")
    poly_single <- marker_polygons %>% filter(detection != "Both")

    threshold_label <- "2% VAF"

    p <- ggplot() +
        geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 2, linetype = threshold_label),
                   colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.7) +
        geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 2, linetype = threshold_label),
                   colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
        scale_linetype_manual(values = setNames("dashed", threshold_label), name = NULL) +
        geom_abline(
            slope = coef(fit)["bulkVAF"], intercept = coef(fit)["(Intercept)"],
            colour = "#d62728", linewidth = 0.8
        ) +
        geom_polygon(
            data = poly_both, aes(x = x, y = y, group = marker_id, fill = detection),
            colour = "black", linewidth = border_width, linetype = "solid"
        ) +
        geom_polygon(
            data = poly_single, aes(x = x, y = y, group = marker_id, fill = detection),
            colour = "black", linewidth = border_width, linetype = "dashed"
        ) +
        geom_point(
            data = vaf_plot_df, aes(x = bulkVAF_plot, y = scVAF_plot, fill = detection),
            shape = 21, size = 0, stroke = 0, alpha = 0, linetype = "solid"
        ) +
        scale_fill_manual(
            values = detection_colours,
            breaks = c("Both", "scDNA only", "Bulk only"), name = NULL
        ) +
        annotate(
            "text", x = axis_limit * 0.97, y = axis_limit * 0.97,
            label = label_text, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
            size = 3.6, family = "sans", lineheight = 1.15
        ) +
        scale_x_continuous(
            name = "Bulk VAF (%)", limits = c(-axis_limit * 0.04, axis_limit),
            breaks = seq(0, axis_limit, by = 20), expand = c(0, 0)
        ) +
        scale_y_continuous(
            name = y_axis_label, limits = c(-axis_limit * 0.04, axis_limit),
            breaks = seq(0, axis_limit, by = 20), expand = c(0, 0)
        ) +
        coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
        theme_classic(base_size = 12, base_family = "sans") +
        theme(
            axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
            axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
            axis.ticks.length = unit(0.18, "cm"),
            axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11),
            axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12),
            panel.grid = element_blank(),
            legend.position = "bottom",
            legend.direction = "horizontal",
            legend.box = "horizontal",
            legend.box.just = "center",
            legend.justification = "center",
            legend.spacing.x = unit(0.6, "cm"),
            legend.box.spacing = unit(0.35, "cm"),
            legend.margin = margin(t = 2, b = 2),
            legend.background = element_blank(),
            legend.key = element_blank(),
            legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
            legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "cm"),
            plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 4, 8)
        ) +
        guides(
            fill = guide_legend(
                order = 1, nrow = 1,
                override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 4.2, stroke = 0.7,
                                     alpha = 1, colour = "black", linetype = "solid")
            ),
            linetype = guide_legend(
                order = 2, nrow = 1,
                override.aes = list(colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.7,
                                     shape = NA, fill = NA)
            )
        )

    resid_plot_df <- vaf_plot_df %>% filter(detection == "Both")
    resid_limit <- max(abs(resid_plot_df$residual_stud)) * 1.1

    p_resid <- ggplot(resid_plot_df, aes(x = fitted, y = residual_stud)) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#d62728", linewidth = 0.8) +
        geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 0.6, colour = "black",
                   fill = detection_colours[["Both"]]) +
        scale_y_continuous(name = "Studentised residual", limits = c(-resid_limit, resid_limit)) +
        scale_x_continuous(name = "Fitted single-cell VAF (%)") +
        theme_classic(base_size = 12, base_family = "sans") +
        theme(
            axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
            axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
            axis.ticks.length = unit(0.18, "cm"),
            axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11),
            axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12),
            panel.grid = element_blank(),
            plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 4, 8)
        )

    list(
        plot = p, residual_plot = p_resid, data = vaf_plot_df,
        fit = fit, residuals = residual_df,
        r2 = r2, p_value = p_value, n_shared = nrow(shared)
    )
}

res <- build_vaf_scatter(
    vaf_table = curated_vaf,
    y_axis_label = "Single-cell VAF (%)",
    set_label = "all_mutations"
)
print(res$plot)
print(res$residual_plot)

cat("\nRegression fit:\n")
cat("R2 =", round(res$r2, 3),
    "| slope =", round(coef(res$fit)["bulkVAF"], 3),
    "| intercept =", round(coef(res$fit)["(Intercept)"], 3),
    "| p =", format.pval(res$p_value, digits = 3),
    "| n =", res$n_shared, "\n")

ggsave(
    file.path(save_dir, "Additional_fig_correlation_vafs.pdf"),
    plot = res$plot, width = 5.2, height = 6.0, device = cairo_pdf
)
ggsave(
    file.path(save_dir, "Additional_fig_correlation_vafs.png"),
    plot = res$plot, width = 5.2, height = 6.0, dpi = 300
)
```
